opening.argument: The presentation offers paid mining packages ranging from a $99 partnership payment through pool options priced at $500, $1,000, and $2,000, up to a $3,500 founder package. It presents the $1,000 pool as generating a daily percentage from mined bitcoins, with funds reinvested in equipment and profit credited to a wallet, while directing viewers to register through the link below the video. The opportunity is further tied to recruitment: bonuses are offered for personally invited partners and for building two teams, including an 8% referral bonus and $200 binary cycles. These are presented as benefits available to participants, alongside a link claiming viewers can earn cryptocurrency safely and easily, rather than as reporting or criticism of the scheme.

citations.quote: http://cryptobiz.site/start - learn how to earn in cryptocurrency safely and easily without trading on exchanges
